description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain (in percentage) of two different supervision regimes—“Strong Supervision” (represented by diagonally striped blue bars) and “Weak Supervision” (represented by solid light blue bars)—across three large language models: “Claude-3.5-Sonnet” and “Qwen2-72B” (a third model is partially visible on the far left but not fully labeled). The vertical axis, labeled “Performance Gain (+%)”, ranges from 0 to 25 with tick marks at intervals of 5. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, strong supervision yields approximately a 15% gain, while weak supervision yields about 10%. For Qwen2-72B, strong supervision results in roughly a 25% gain, and weak supervision yields approximately 15%. The chart is tilted diagonally, with category labels on the horizontal axis and the legend positioned at the top left. The bars are grouped by model, with strong supervision consistently outperforming weak supervision in both visible cases. The chart visually emphasizes the superior performance of strong supervision across models, with the tallest bar reaching 25% for Qwen2-72B under strong supervision.
